constant_vectors_are_not_a_bug: architectural difference does not guarantee error variance. A system scoring 0 of n or n of n on some failure type yields a constant vector and phi does not exist for that pair. It is reported undefined, never 0.0, which is what PMLAB-DECORR-E1 was built to do honestly
correlation_is_two_level: phi over a binary error vector answers whether two systems fail on the same probes. It cannot answer whether they fail the same way, so each failure type also gets its own one-hot vector and its own phi. Two systems can share an error rate, fail on the same probes, and diverge completely once type is separated
enforced_by: scripts/comparative_lab.py::validate, which refuses rather than warns

interaction_term.near_zero: additive — the mechanisms address different failures
interaction_term.positive: synergistic — the pair exceeds the sum of independent effects
interaction_term.worked: deltas of +6 and +8 giving +14 is additive; giving +8 is heavy redundancy; giving +17 is a positive interaction of about +3 over the sum of independent effects

tested_by: tests/test_comparative_lab.py — 14 tests covering refusal, undefined phi and the interaction
why_frozen_before_the_first_system_is_re: a contract written after the first system is in hand gets shaped by what that system happens to emit, and every later system is then measured against one system's conveniences
